parent_protocol.inherited: training, kernel, optimizer, initialization, temperature sets, objectives, fit selection, search, confirmation, final fitting, failures; all unchanged

family.name: independent_twisted_parity
family.encoder: R_x(-pi/4)^{(x)15} T(mu) on the 15 leaves, T(mu)=exp[-i (mu/15) sum_{i<j<=15} Z_i Z_j] (one-axis twist followed by a fixed collective pi/4 turn); phi(beta) = P(t) [R_x(-pi/4)^{(x)15} T(mu)|+>^15] (x) |+>, P(t)=exp[-i (t/2) sum_{i<16} Z_i Z_16]; sin t = tanh(a beta^2), mu = kappa beta cos t; gates: H on every qubit, IsingZZ(2mu/15) on every leaf pair, RX(-pi/4) on every leaf, IsingZZ(t) from each leaf to the root; mu=0 gives the parity encoder with star angle t (the kappa=0 control state); implementation paper_experiments/twisted_parity_encoder.py
family.kappa_policy: fixed design constant, not searched; kappa = 0.4 and the fixed pi/4 turn were set in a preliminary comparison of encoder variants on development temperatures only (2026-10-18); the test temperatures 0.4, 1.0, 2.0 and the 101-point grid were never used
family.beta_scale_policy: beta_scale is the schedule constant a, searched log-uniformly on [0.3, 0.7]; it is not in the parity encoder's units, so the parent range does not apply
family.search_space: shared_parity learning_rate, init_scale, b1, one_minus_beta2, schedule and kernel_pair with the parent ranges and priors; beta_scale on beta_scale_range
family.ansatz: complete one- and two-body, 136 phases, no ancillas
family.role: temperature-specific baseline for shared_twisted_parity: one circuit fitted directly at each marker temperature 0.4, 1.0, 2.0, as independent_parity is for shared_parity

randomness.fit_streams: parent namespace cw-parity-hpo-followup-20261009 and keys; fit streams pair with the independent_parity fits at every stage, repeat, marker and start; the same streams as the squeezed parity campaign
randomness.sampler_keys: (sampler, independent_twisted_parity, random|tpe) in the parent namespace; independent of the samplers
